questionSnapshot.question: In Finding Dory, where does Dory discover she grew up?
answers: The Marine Life Institute in Morro Bay, California
The Great Barrier Reef in Australia

notes: Read all four options, full matching topic digests and cross-bank comparisons; checked wording, category, editorial difficulty and main-film scope. Challenged later reef home versus childhood home and geographic alternatives. Pixar confirms MLI/Morro Bay/California, but not childhood by itself. Third-party film-dialogue transcription explicitly says born there; the independent plot account corroborates childhood pipe-pal and undertow separation. Direct studio screenplay unavailable: limitation retained rather than claiming the homepage alone proves childhood.
